literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: CDC 协议正确识别了 300 个样本中的 291 个,产生 141 个真阳性、150 个真阴性、9 个假阴性,没有假阳性。 [10.1128/spectrum.01431-26]
在 53 例 猴痘 病例和 248 例匹配对照中,13.7% 的病例患有严重的 猴痘。CYV 斜率增加与调整后联合建模中获得 猴痘 的较高风险相关[风险比 1.11 (95% CI 1.04–1.18)]。 [10.1097/qad.0000000000004606]

主要发现包括确定了一个“沉默时代”(1970-2016),其特点是西非野生动物(主要是啮齿动物和小型哺乳动物)中 MPXV 的神秘地方性传播。2017 年尼日利亚的重新出现标志着一种范式转变,猴痘 从零星的农村儿科感染转变为持续的城市 传播,特别是在年轻成年男性中。基因组分析表明,进化枝 II 在大约 3500 年前与进化枝 I 分化,其中进化枝 IIb 表现出与 APOBEC3 介导的超突变一致的加速微进化,这表明早在 2014 年,人与人之间的 传播 链中就存在神秘循环。 [10.3390/zoonoticdis6030035]
在无控制场景模拟中,第100天累计感染人数达到6331人。在从单控制到四重控制的15种最佳控制方案中,实施任何方案都可以有效减少感染总数。 [10.1186/s12889-026-28925-6]
分支 1,主要分布在中非和东非,表现出毒力基因(D14L,补体控制蛋白)的关键缺失和高 死亡率 率(高达 10%)。分支 2 在西非和全球流行,表现出广泛的 APOBEC3 型 突变、移码和串联重复,疾病较轻,人与人之间的 传播 增强。毒力和免疫逃避基因的遗传差异从根本上影响 猴痘 进化枝的 暴发 特征。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10664239/v1]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The CDC protocol correctly identified 291 of 300 samples, yielding 141 true positives, 150 true negatives, 9 false negatives, and no false positives. [10.1128/spectrum.01431-26]

The mean age was 32.0 years (SD 10.7); 51.9% (2,056/3,960) were female, 80.2% resided in high-burden districts, 60.9% perceived themselves at risk, 18.7% had comprehensive knowledge of Mpox, 53.8% reported adequate prevention practice despite 93.2% message exposure, and comprehensive knowledge (aPR 1.32, 95% CI 1.15–1.52) and message exposure (aPR 1.88, 95% CI 1.31–2.71) were independently associated with practice. [10.64898/2026.08.12.26360257]

Among 53 mpox cases and 248 matched controls, 13.7% of cases had severe mpox. An increased slope of CYV was associated with higher risk of mpox acquisition in joint modeling after adjustment [hazard ratio 1.11 (95% CI 1.04–1.18)]. [10.1097/qad.0000000000004606]

Key findings include the identification of an 'Era of Silence' (1970–2016) marked by cryptic enzootic circulation of MPXV in West African wildlife, primarily rodents and small mammals. [10.3390/zoonoticdis6030035]

In the no-control scenario simulation, cumulative infections reached 6331 by day 100. Across 15 optimal control schemes ranging from single to quadruple controls, implementing any scheme reduced total infections effectively. [10.1186/s12889-026-28925-6]

news.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: CDC 报告正在进行的 I 型分支和 II 型分支 猴痘 暴发 已确诊病例、与旅行相关的传播和低死亡率;指南强调 疫苗接种 和 监测。 [news-104d37adc31ac019]
自 2023 年底以来,中非和东非已报道了 I 支猴痘的 暴发,西欧和美国也报告了较新的 暴发。疾病预防控制中心已确认这些 暴发 并正在监测其传播情况。暴发 的特征是通过性接触、家庭接触和接触受感染的动物来表现 传播。 [news-a6dd88c71fded4d9]
纽约市健康和心理卫生局报告,从欧洲返回的旅行者中确诊的 猴痘 分支 I 病例有所增加;纽约市首例已知的 I 型分支病例于 2026 年 3 月报告(N2、N3、N4、N6)。 [news-5fa9b308f92ed364]
据报告,欧洲 猴痘 病例模式发生转变:分支 I 病例基本保持稳定,而分支 II 病例继续下降;ECDC 监测 更新于 2026 年 8 月 14 日发布。 [news-56942c994b437ddf]
随着病毒继续传播,达米安中心敦促高危印第安纳波利斯居民接种 猴痘 疫苗。该中心提供有关 疫苗 及其管理的信息。 [news-41e444fef11a5ba5]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Mpox virus news developments.
key_findings_en: CDC reports ongoing clade I and clade II mpox outbreaks with confirmed cases, travel-associated spread, and low death rates; guidance emphasizes vaccination and surveillance. [news-104d37adc31ac019]

Outbreaks of clade I monkeypox have been reported in Central and Eastern Africa since late 2023, with newer outbreaks in Western Europe and the U.S. The CDC has confirmed these outbreaks and is monitoring their spread. [news-a6dd88c71fded4d9]

NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene reports a rise in confirmed mpox clade I cases among travelers returning from Europe; first known clade I case in NYC was reported in March 2026 (N2, N3, N4, N6). [news-5fa9b308f92ed364]

Reported shift in mpox case patterns in Europe: clade I cases remain broadly steady while clade II cases continue to decline; ECDC surveillance update released on 14 August 2026. [news-56942c994b437ddf]

The Damien Center is urging at-risk Indianapolis residents to get vaccinated against mpox as the virus continues to spread. The center is providing information about the vaccine and its administration. [news-41e444fef11a5ba5]

papers.title: Mpox Airborne Transmission: A Systematic Review.
papers.abstract: Since May 2022, mpox has been reported across multiple nonendemic regions, with concurrent outbreaks in diverse geographic settings, raising concerns about broader international spread. However, evidence regarding the risk of airborne transmission remains limited. We conducted a systematic review to evaluate the risk of airborne transmission and the presence of viable viruses in air samples. PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies published in English, including environmental studies, case reports, cross-sectional studies, and cohort studies. Data extraction included study characteristics (authors, year, design, and setting), sample size, diagnostic methods, participant characteristics, follow-up, type of respiratory particles assessed (droplets and/or aerosols), and key findings. Of 286 records identified, four studies met the inclusion criteria. All were environmental studies published between 2022 and 2023. MPXV DNA was detected in surface and air samples, with cycle threshold (Ct) values ranging from < 30 to < 45. However, none of the studies demonstrated consistent viral viability in aerosols or droplets sufficient to support airborne transmission. Overall, the available evidence is limited and does not support a clear risk of airborne infection. Further well-designed studies in human settings are needed to clarify the potential for mpox transmission through respiratory routes. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: PROSPERO: CRD42023391123.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 猴痘 空气传播的风险以及空气样本中是否存在活病毒,因为 猴痘 已在多个非流行地区报告,并担心国际传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对猴痘的空气传播传播的风险进行了系统评价,包括2022年至2023年期间发表的环境研究、病例报告、横断面研究和队列研究研究。
elements_zh.methods: 该综述涉及搜索 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Cochrane 图书馆以英文发表的研究,提取有关研究特征、样本量、诊断方法、参与者特征、评估的呼吸颗粒物和主要发现的数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 在表面和空气样本中检测到 MPXV DNA,循环阈值 (Ct) 值范围为 < 30 至 < 45。然而,没有一项研究表明气溶胶或液滴中病毒的生存能力一致,足以支持空气中的 传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,现有证据并不支持空气传播感染的明显风险,强调需要在人类环境中进行进一步精心设计的研究,以阐明 猴痘 传播 通过呼吸道途径的可能性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,目前的证据不足以证实猴痘在空气中传播,这对公共卫生措施以及制定有针对性的监测和预防策略具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据有限且基于环境研究,可能无法完全代表人类 传播 动态,导致结论的置信度评估适中。

However, evidence regarding the risk of airborne transmission remains limited. We conducted a systematic review to evaluate the risk of airborne transmission and the presence of viable viruses in air samples. PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies published in English, including environmental studies, case reports, cross-sectional studies, and cohort studies. Data extraction included study characteristics (authors, year, design, and setting), sample size, diagnostic methods, participant characteristics, follow-up, type of respiratory particles assessed (droplets and/or aerosols), and key findings. Of 286 records identified, four studies met the inclusion criteria. All were environmental studies published between 2022 and 2023. MPXV DNA was detected in surface and air samples, with cycle threshold (Ct) values ranging from < 30 to < 45. However, none of the studies demonstrated consistent viral viability in aerosols or droplets sufficient to support airborne transmission. Overall, the available evidence is limited and does not support a clear risk of airborne infection. papers.title: Emerging infectious diseases (Mpox, Nipah, and Andes): A narrative review of transmission, environmental survival, and disinfection
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus are emerging infectious diseases that cause outbreaks associated with nosocomial transmission. METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.

papers.title: Five Decades of Mpox in West Africa: History, Epidemiology, Viral Evolution, and Reservoir Ecology (1970–2025)
papers.abstract: Historically, mpox was thought to be a geographically constrained ‘disease of poverty,’ leading to decades of neglect by global health actors. Waning population immunity from the cessation of smallpox vaccination and prolonged scientific neglect created conditions that enabled the monkeypox virus (MPXV) to adapt cryptically. This ultimately contributed to the emergence of unprecedented global public health crises. This review aims to systematically trace the history, epidemiology, genomic evolution, and reservoir ecology of mpox in West Africa from 1970 to 2025. Following PRISMA guidelines, 110 articles met the inclusion criteria and were synthesized to map the virus’s trajectory. For nearly four decades, an “Era of Silence” (1970–2016) masked the silent enzootic circulation of MPXV within West African wildlife, primarily rodents and small mammals. This epidemiological quiescence ended with the 2017 re-emergence in Nigeria, which signaled a fundamental paradigm shift. The disease profile transitioned from sporadic, rural paediatric infections to sustained, urban and secondary transmission among young adult males. This shift was often associated with sexual networks, especially among men who have sex with men, and was characterized by novel clinical presentations, including genital and perianal lesions. Genomic analyses revealed that clade II diverged from clade I approximately 3500 years ago and is uniquely defined by the deletion of virulence factors, such as the complement-binding protein. Importantly, the clade IIb lineage, which triggered the 2022 global outbreak, exhibits accelerated microevolution consistent with APOBEC3-mediated hypermutation. This host-driven mutational signature provides genomic evidence supporting the hypothesis that clade IIb circulated cryptically within human-to-human transmission chains in West Africa as early as 2014. papers.title_original: Five Decades of Mpox in West Africa: History, Epidemiology, Viral Evolution, and Reservoir Ecology (1970–2025)

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the monkeypox virus (MPXV), its clades (clade I, clade II, clade IIb), and mpox disease within West Africa from 1970 to 2025, focusing on the central question of how historical neglect, epidemiological shifts, and genomic evolution contributed to the virus's transition from a rare zoonosis to a global public health threat.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a systematic review conducted following PRISMA guidelines, synthesizing 110 included articles to map the trajectory of MPXV in West Africa. The review traces historical, epidemiological, genomic, and ecological dimensions of mpox from 1970 to 2025.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Key findings include the identification of an 'Era of Silence' (1970–2016) marked by cryptic enzootic circulation of MPXV in West African wildlife, primarily rodents and small mammals. The 2017 re-emergence in Nigeria signaled a paradigm shift, with mpox transitioning from sporadic rural pediatric infections to sustained urban transmission, particularly among young adult males. Genomic analyses indicate clade II diverged from clade I approximately 3500 years ago, with clade IIb exhibiting accelerated microevolution consistent with APOBEC3-mediated hypermutation, suggesting cryptic circulation within human-to-human transmission chains as early as 2014.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights unresolved ecological questions, including the lack of definitive reservoir identification for MPXV despite evidence suggesting diverse rodents and an expanding host range. Additionally, the mechanisms underlying the shift from zoonotic spillover to sustained human transmission remain poorly understood, particularly regarding the role of sexual networks in driving transmission dynamics.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the urgent need for integrated 'One Health' surveillance systems to detect and respond to cryptic MPXV circulation. It calls for enhanced genomic surveillance to monitor viral evolution, particularly APOBEC3-driven mutations, and for targeted research into reservoir ecology and transmission mechanisms to inform public health interventions and risk assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review traces the history, epidemiology, genomic evolution, and reservoir ecology of mpox in West Africa from 1970 to 2025. It identifies a prolonged 'Era of Silence' with cryptic circulation of monkeypox virus (MPXV) in wildlife, followed by a 2017 re-emergence in Nigeria that marked a shift from sporadic rural infections to sustained urban transmission, particularly among young adult males. Genomic analyses reveal clade II diverged from clade I ~3500 years ago, with clade IIb showing accelerated APOBEC3-mediated microevolution, suggesting cryptic human-to-human circulation as early as 2014. Key gaps include unresolved reservoir ecology and transmission mechanisms, while the review emphasizes the need for integrated 'One Health' surveillance and enhanced genomic monitoring to address the virus's evolving threat.

elements_en.scope_and_question: The review examines the monkeypox virus (MPXV), its clades (clade I, clade II, clade IIb), and mpox disease within West Africa from 1970 to 2025, focusing on the central question of how historical neglect, epidemiological shifts, and genomic evolution contributed to the virus's transition from a rare zoonosis to a global public health threat.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a systematic review conducted following PRISMA guidelines, synthesizing 110 included articles to map the trajectory of MPXV in West Africa. The review traces historical, epidemiological, genomic, and ecological dimensions of mpox from 1970 to 2025.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Key findings include the identification of an 'Era of Silence' (1970–2016) marked by cryptic enzootic circulation of MPXV in West African wildlife, primarily rodents and small mammals. The 2017 re-emergence in Nigeria signaled a paradigm shift, with mpox transitioning from sporadic rural pediatric infections to sustained urban transmission, particularly among young adult males. Genomic analyses indicate clade II diverged from clade I approximately 3500 years ago, with clade IIb exhibiting accelerated microevolution consistent with APOBEC3-mediated hypermutation, suggesting cryptic circulation within human-to-human transmission chains as early as 2014.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights unresolved ecological questions, including the lack of definitive reservoir identification for MPXV despite evidence suggesting diverse rodents and an expanding host range. Additionally, the mechanisms underlying the shift from zoonotic spillover to sustained human transmission remain poorly understood, particularly regarding the role of sexual networks in driving transmission dynamics.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the urgent need for integrated 'One Health' surveillance systems to detect and respond to cryptic MPXV circulation. It calls for enhanced genomic surveillance to monitor viral evolution, particularly APOBEC3-driven mutations, and for targeted research into reservoir ecology and transmission mechanisms to inform public health interventions and risk assessment.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述考察了 1970 年至 2025 年西非境内的猴痘病毒 (MPXV)、其分支(分支 I、分支 II、分支 IIb)和 猴痘 疾病,重点关注历史忽视、流行病学变化和基因组 进化 如何导致该病毒从罕见的 人兽共患病 转变为全球公共卫生威胁的核心问题。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是根据 PRISMA 指南进行的系统评价,综合了 110 篇纳入的文章,以绘制西非 MPXV 的轨迹。该综述追溯了 1970 年至 2025 年 猴痘 的历史、流行病学、基因组和生态维度。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 主要发现包括确定了一个“沉默时代”(1970-2016),其特点是西非野生动物(主要是啮齿动物和小型哺乳动物)中 MPXV 的神秘地方性传播。2017 年尼日利亚的重新出现标志着一种范式转变,猴痘 从零星的农村儿科感染转变为持续的城市 传播,特别是在年轻成年男性中。基因组分析表明,进化枝 II 在大约 3500 年前与进化枝 I 分化,其中进化枝 IIb 表现出与 APOBEC3 介导的超突变一致的加速微进化,这表明早在 2014 年,人与人之间的 传播 链中就存在神秘循环。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了尚未解决的生态问题,包括尽管有证据表明啮齿类动物多种多样且 宿主 范围不断扩大,但缺乏对 MPXV 的明确 储存宿主 鉴定。此外,从人畜共患 跨物种溢出 到持续人类 传播 转变的机制仍然知之甚少,特别是关于性网络在驱动 传播 动态中的作用。

papers.title_zh: 西非 猴痘 的五个十年:历史、流行病学、病毒 进化 和 储存宿主 生态学(1970-2025)
papers.source_body_en: Historically, mpox was thought to be a geographically constrained ‘disease of poverty,’ leading to decades of neglect by global health actors. Waning population immunity from the cessation of smallpox vaccination and prolonged scientific neglect created conditions that enabled the monkeypox virus (MPXV) to adapt cryptically. This ultimately contributed to the emergence of unprecedented global public health crises. This review aims to systematically trace the history, epidemiology, genomic evolution, and reservoir ecology of mpox in West Africa from 1970 to 2025. Following PRISMA guidelines, 110 articles met the inclusion criteria and were synthesized to map the virus’s trajectory. For nearly four decades, an “Era of Silence” (1970–2016) masked the silent enzootic circulation of MPXV within West African wildlife, primarily rodents and small mammals. This epidemiological quiescence ended with the 2017 re-emergence in Nigeria, which signaled a fundamental paradigm shift. The disease profile transitioned from sporadic, rural paediatric infections to sustained, urban and secondary transmission among young adult males. This shift was often associated with sexual networks, especially among men who have sex with men, and was characterized by novel clinical presentations, including genital and perianal lesions. Genomic analyses revealed that clade II diverged from clade I approximately 3500 years ago and is uniquely defined by the deletion of virulence factors, such as the complement-binding protein. Importantly, the clade IIb lineage, which triggered the 2022 global outbreak, exhibits accelerated microevolution consistent with APOBEC3-mediated hypermutation. This host-driven mutational signature provides genomic evidence supporting the hypothesis that clade IIb circulated cryptically within human-to-human transmission chains in West Africa as early as 2014. Ecologically, while no definitive reservoir has yet been identified, evidence suggests diverse rodents and an expanding host range. The transformation of mpox from a rare zoonosis to a global threat underscores the severe consequences of delayed intervention, demanding robust, integrated “One Health” surveillance.
papers.abstract_zh: 从历史上看,猴痘 被认为是一种受地理限制的“贫困病”,导致全球卫生行为者数十年的忽视。由于天花 疫苗接种 停止而导致的人群免疫力下降以及长期的科学忽视,为猴痘病毒(MPXV)的神秘适应创造了条件。这最终导致了前所未有的全球公共卫生危机的出现。本综述旨在系统地追溯 1970 年至 2025 年西非 流行病学 的历史、流行病学、基因组 进化 和 猴痘 生态。按照 PRISMA 指南,110 篇符合纳入标准的文章被合成,以绘制病毒的轨迹。近四十年来,“沉默时代”(1970-2016)掩盖了西非野生动物(主要是啮齿动物和小型哺乳动物)中 MPXV 的无声传播。这种流行病学的平静随着 2017 年尼日利亚的重新出现而结束,这标志着根本性的范式转变。疾病特征从散发的农村儿童感染转变为年轻成年男性中持续的城市继发性 传播。这种转变通常与性网络有关,尤其是在男男性行为者中,其特点是新的临床表现,包括生殖器和肛周病变。基因组分析显示,大约 3500 年前,进化枝 II 与进化枝 I 分叉,并且通过删除补体结合蛋白等毒力因子来独特定义。重要的是,引发 2022 年全球 暴发 的进化枝 IIb 谱系表现出与 APOBEC3 介导的超突变一致的加速微进化。这种 宿主 驱动的突变特征提供了基因组证据,支持这样的假设:分支 IIb 早在 2014 年就在西非人与人之间的 传播 链中神秘地循环。从生态角度来看,虽然尚未确定明确的 储存宿主,但有证据表明啮齿类动物多种多样,并且 宿主 范围不断扩大。猴痘 从罕见的 人兽共患病 转变为全球威胁,凸显了延迟干预的严重后果,需要强大、综合的“同一个健康”监测。

papers.title: Syndromic surveillance for mpox during a large religious mass gathering amid an ongoing outbreak, Uganda, 2025: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Large religious mass gatherings can facilitate infectious disease transmission through crowding, prolonged close contact, shared facilities, and extensive population movement. The 2025 Uganda Martyrs Day commemoration occurred during an ongoing national mpox outbreak. We describe the implementation of syndromic surveillance for mpox during a large religious mass gathering and the yield of mpox-compatible illness detected among pilgrims. We conducted a cross-sectional symptom-screening survey and retrospectively reviewed emergency medical services (EMS) records from the Namugongo Catholic and Protestant shrines during 29 May-5 June 2025. Pilgrims aged [≥]18 years were selected through systematic sampling at entrance gates and random sampling within demarcated zones. Mpox-compatible illness was defined as acute fever ([≥]38.5{degrees}C) with rash and at least one of headache, lymphadenopathy, back pain, myalgia, or profound weakness. We summarized participant characteristics, reported symptoms, mpox-compatible illness, and provisional diagnoses among pilgrims seeking care. Of 1,523 pilgrims approached, 1,299 participated (85.3% response rate); median age was 35 years (interquartile range: 25-49), and 752 (57.9%) were male. Among actively screened pilgrims, 73 (5.6%) reported [≥]2 mpox-related symptoms, and seven (0.5%) met the mpox-compatible illness definition. Among 5,216 pilgrims who sought care, 3,415 (65.5%) had documented presenting symptoms; of these, 628 (18.4%) had mpox-related syndromic presentations. Among all 5,216 care-seekers, the most common provisional diagnoses were peptic ulcer disease (n=563; 10.8%), respiratory tract infection (n=482; 9.2%), malaria (n=190; 3.6%), urinary tract infection (n=96; 1.8%), and gastritis (n=79; 1.5%). Active symptom screening suggested a low prevalence of mpox-compatible illness in the general pilgrim population, whereas EMS records identified a larger syndromic signal among pilgrims who sought care. Combining both approaches with standardized documentation, clinical triage, laboratory confirmation, and follow-up could improve detection during mass gatherings

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the use of syndromic surveillance for mpox virus during a large religious mass gathering in Uganda in 2025, focusing on the central question of whether such surveillance can detect mpox-compatible illness among pilgrims during an ongoing national mpox outbreak.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review describes a cross-sectional symptom-screening survey and retrospective review of emergency medical services (EMS) records conducted at the Namugongo Catholic and Protestant shrines from 29 May to 5 June 2025, using systematic and random sampling methods among pilgrims aged 18 years or older.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Active symptom screening identified a low prevalence of mpox-compatible illness (0.5%) among actively screened pilgrims, while EMS records among care-seekers showed a larger syndromic signal (18.4% with mpox-related presentations), suggesting that syndromic surveillance in care-seeking populations may yield higher detection rates during mass gatherings.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights a discrepancy between active screening and EMS records in detecting mpox-compatible illness, indicating potential limitations in surveillance sensitivity or case ascertainment methods. Additionally, the study does not report laboratory confirmation for all syndromic cases, leaving uncertainty about the true burden of mpox.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that combining active symptom screening with standardized documentation, clinical triage, laboratory confirmation, and follow-up could improve mpox detection during mass gatherings, particularly by leveraging syndromic surveillance in care-seeking populations.

The findings underscore the potential of syndromic surveillance in care-seeking populations to enhance detection during mass gatherings, while also revealing gaps in sensitivity and the need for standardized diagnostic confirmation.

papers.abstract_zh: 大型宗教群众集会通过拥挤、长时间密切接触、共用设施和广泛的人口流动,可能助长传染病。2025 年乌干达烈士日纪念活动是在正在进行的全国 猴痘 暴发 活动期间举行的。我们描述了在大型宗教群众集会期间对 猴痘 进行综合征 监测 的实施情况,以及在朝圣者中检测到的 猴痘 兼容疾病的产生情况。我们进行了横断面症状筛查调查,并回顾性审查了纳穆贡戈天主教和新教圣地2025年5月29日至6月5日期间的紧急医疗服务(EMS)记录。通过在入口处系统抽样和在划定区域内随机抽样,选择了年龄≥18岁的朝圣者。猴痘 兼容疾病被定义为急性发热([≥]38.5{°C),伴有皮疹以及头痛、淋巴结肿大、背痛、肌痛或极度虚弱中的至少一种。我们总结了寻求护理的朝圣者的参与者特征、报告的症状、猴痘 兼容疾病和临时诊断。在 1,523 名朝圣者中,有 1,299 人参与(回应率为 85.3%);中位年龄为 35 岁(四分位距:25-49),其中 752 名(57.9%)为男性。在积极筛查的朝圣者中,73 名 (5.6%) 报告了 [≥]2 猴痘 相关症状,7 名 (0.5%) 符合 猴痘 兼容疾病定义。在 5,216 名寻求治疗的朝圣者中,有 3,415 人(65.5%)记录出现症状;其中,628 人(18.4%)有 猴痘 相关症状。在所有 5,216 名寻求护理者中,最常见的临时诊断是消化性溃疡病(n=563;10.8%)、呼吸道感染(n=482;9.2%)、疟疾(n=190;3.6%)、尿路感染(n=96;1.8%)和胃炎(n=79;1.5%)。主动症状筛查表明,一般朝圣者人群中 患病率 的 猴痘 兼容疾病较低,而 EMS 记录在寻求护理的朝圣者中发现了更大的症状信号。将这两种方法与标准化文件、临床分诊、实验室确认和随访相结合可以改善群众集会期间的检测

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查描述了 2025 年 5 月 29 日至 6 月 5 日在纳穆贡戈天主教和新教圣地进行的横断面症状筛查调查和对紧急医疗服务 (EMS) 记录的回顾性审查,采用系统和随机抽样方法,对 18 岁或以上的朝圣者进行调查。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 主动症状筛查在主动筛查的朝圣者中发现了低 患病率 的 猴痘 兼容疾病 (0.5%),而寻求护理者中的 EMS 记录显示出更大的症状信号(18.4% 具有 猴痘 相关的表现),这表明寻求护理人群中的症状 监测 可能在群众集会期间产生更高的检出率。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了主动筛查和 EMS 记录在检测 猴痘 兼容疾病方面的差异,表明 猴痘 敏感性或病例确定方法的潜在局限性。此外,该研究并未报告所有综合征病例的实验室确认,这使得 猴痘 的真实负担存在不确定性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,将主动症状筛查与标准化记录、临床分诊、实验室确认和随访相结合可以改善群众集会期间的 猴痘 检测,特别是通过在寻求护理的人群中利用综合征型 猴痘。

papers.title: Socio-ecological determinants of Mpox transmission risk in Uganda: mapping community-level risk and protective factors, a multi-district cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Background: Uganda is among the African countries most affected by the ongoing clade Ib Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak, with sustained community transmission since 2024. Effective community-level prevention depends on understanding how risk and protective factors are distributed across the social ecology. We applied a socio-ecological framework to map the determinants of Mpox transmission risk and protective practice in affected districts. Methods We conducted a multi-district, community-based cross-sectional survey of 3,960 community members aged 15–65 years across high- and low-burden districts in Uganda between February and March 2025. Participants were selected by multistage sampling and interviewed using a structured tool administered on tablets. Individual-, household-, community- and structural-level characteristics were summarised descriptively. A modified Poisson regression model with district-clustered robust standard errors was used to estimate crude and adjusted prevalence ratios (cPR, aPR) for adequate Mpox prevention and control practice; the multivariable model included 3,916 participants with complete covariate data. Analyses were performed in R version 4.5.0. Results The mean age was 32.0 years (SD 10.7); 51.9% (2,056/3,960) were female and most had secondary education (54.2%). Comorbidity burden was substantial (sexually transmitted infections 28.3%, HIV 13.9%, tuberculosis 8.2%, malnutrition 6.2%). Four in five participants (80.2%) resided in high-burden districts and 60.9% perceived themselves at risk, yet only 18.7% had comprehensive knowledge of Mpox and 53.8% reported adequate prevention practice despite near-universal message exposure (93.2%). In adjusted analysis, comprehensive knowledge (aPR 1.32, 95% CI 1.15–1.52) and message exposure (aPR 1.88, 95% CI 1.31–2.71) were by far the strongest protective determinants; several occupational, income, education and religious categories were also independently associated with practice, whereas biological comorbidities were not. Conclusions Mpox transmission risk in Uganda is concentrated in high-burden districts and overlaps with a heavy comorbidity burden. Although some social and structural factors were independently associated with protective practice, it was driven primarily by the modifiable cognitive factors of knowledge and message exposure rather than by biological characteristics. Community-level interventions that convert near-universal message reach into accurate, actionable knowledge are likely to yield the greatest protective gains.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 自 2024 年以来,乌干达面临着 Ib 猴痘 进化枝的持续社区 传播,迫切需要了解风险和保护因素如何在社会生态中分布,以便为预防策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025 年 2 月至 3 月,采用多阶段抽样的方式,对乌干达高负担区和低负担区的 3,960 名 15 岁至 65 岁的社区成员进行了一项多区、以社区为基础的横断面调查。
elements_zh.methods: 使用平板电脑上管理的结构化工具对参与者进行采访,并对个人、家庭、社区和结构层面的特征进行了描述性总结;具有区域聚类稳健标准误差的改进泊松回归模型估计了粗略和调整后的 患病率 比率,以实现充分的 猴痘 预防和控制实践。
elements_zh.main_results: The mean age was 32.0 years (SD 10.7); 51.9% (2,056/3,960) were female, 80.2% resided in high-burden districts, 60.9% perceived themselves at risk, 18.7% had comprehensive knowledge of Mpox, 53.8% reported adequate prevention practice despite 93.2% message exposure, and comprehensive knowledge (aPR 1.32, 95% CI 1.15–1.52) and message exposure (aPR 1.88, 95% CI 1.31–2.71) were independently associated with practice.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究解释说,猴痘 传播 风险集中在高负担地区,并与沉重的合并症负担重叠,但保护实践主要是由可改变的认知因素(知识和信息暴露)驱动的,而不是生物学特征。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,社区层面的干预措施将几乎普遍的信息转化为准确、可操作的知识,可能会对乌干达的 Ib 猴痘 分支产生最大的保护效果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横断面设计限制了因果推理,对自我报告的实践和知识的依赖可能会引入社会期望偏差;尽管样本很大且具有代表性,但由于这些局限性,证据被评估为中等。

papers.title: Mpox virus clade evolution and epidemiology in Africa: a systematic review of genetic variability and clinical impact
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: The Mpox virus (MPXV), formerly known as monkeypox virus, is re-emerging in endemic and non-endemic regions, driven in part by divergent genetic lineages: Clade 1 and Clade 2. Objective : This systematic review synthesizes current evidence on the genomic variability of MPXV in Africa and its relationship to clinical severity, transmission dynamics, and outbreak patterns. Methods : Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, and other relevant databases to identify studies comparing Clade 1 and Clade 2. Data extraction included mutation profiling, outbreak size, and transmission dynamics. Results : Eleven studies met inclusion criteria. Clade 1, predominant in Central and East Africa, exhibits key deletions in virulence genes (D14L, complement control protein) and high mortality rates (up to 10%). Clade 2, prevalent in West Africa and globally, shows extensive APOBEC3-type mutations, frameshifts, and tandem repeats, with milder disease and enhanced human-to-human transmission. Conclusion : Genetic differences in virulence and immune evasion genes fundamentally influence outbreak characteristics across Mpox clades. Improved genomic surveillance is critical for public health preparedness.

Objective : This systematic review synthesizes current evidence on the genomic variability of MPXV in Africa and its relationship to clinical severity, transmission dynamics, and outbreak patterns. Methods : Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, and other relevant databases to identify studies comparing Clade 1 and Clade 2. Data extraction included mutation profiling, outbreak size, and transmission dynamics. Results : Eleven studies met inclusion criteria. Clade 1, predominant in Central and East Africa, exhibits key deletions in virulence genes (D14L, complement control protein) and high mortality rates (up to 10%). Clade 2, prevalent in West Africa and globally, shows extensive APOBEC3-type mutations, frameshifts, and tandem repeats, with milder disease and enhanced human-to-human transmission. Conclusion : Genetic differences in virulence and immune evasion genes fundamentally influence outbreak characteristics across Mpox clades. Improved genomic surveillance is critical for public health preparedness.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查重点关注 猴痘病毒 (MPXV)(以前称为猴痘病毒),检查其在非洲的分支 进化 和 流行病学。核心问题是 MPXV 进化枝的基因组变异与其临床严重程度、传播 动态和 暴发 模式之间的关系。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述遵循 PRISMA 指南并检索了 Semantic Sc​​holar、PubMed、Google Scholar 和其他相关数据库。资格标准包括比较 MPXV 分支 1 和分支 2 的研究,数据提取侧重于 突变 分析、暴发 大小和 传播 动态。

papers.title: Insights into the Life Cycle and Therapeutic Agents for Monkeypox Virus Infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Since the first confirmed case in 1970, the monkeypox virus (MPXV) has emerged as a significant threat to global public health. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on two occasions. Despite decades of research, only tecovirimat has been approved by the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for the treatment of MPXV infection. The genome and structure are similar between MPXV and other orthopoxviruses (OPXVs), suggesting that the strategies used for other OPXVs may be applicable to MPXV. This review systematically summarizes the genome, structure, and critical stages in the life cycle of OPXVs, especially MPXV. A variety of antiviral agents against MPXV and other OPXVs are discussed according to their distinct mechanisms of action: 1) blocking viral entry and fusion, 2) inhibiting DNA replication and processing, 3) disrupting transcription and mRNA processing, 4) preventing virion assembly, maturation and release, 5) modulating immune responses, and 6) mechanism unknown. Overall, this article provides a systematic review of current research progress on potential therapeutic targets and agent for MPXV, aiming to offer innovative insights and strategies for the development of effective therapeutic agents against mpox.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the life cycle of the monkeypox virus (MPXV) and the therapeutic agents available for its treatment. The central question is to provide a systematic summary of current research progress on potential therapeutic targets and agents for MPXV, aiming to offer innovative insights and strategies for the development of effective therapeutic agents against mpox. The topic boundary includes MPXV clades and mpox disease, with related viruses such as variola virus, smallpox, cowpox virus, vaccinia virus, molluscum contagiosum virus, and camelpox virus considered supplementary unless material target-specific evidence is also present.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review systematically summarizes the genome, structure, and critical stages in the life cycle of orthopoxviruses (OPXVs), especially MPXV. It discusses a variety of antiviral agents against MPXV and other OPXVs according to their distinct mechanisms of action, including blocking viral entry and fusion, inhibiting DNA replication and processing, disrupting transcription and mRNA processing, preventing virion assembly, maturation and release, modulating immune responses, and mechanisms unknown. The review does not explicitly report on the meta-analysis or consensus process.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that the genome and structure of MPXV are similar to those of other orthopoxviruses (OPXVs), suggesting that strategies used for other OPXVs may be applicable to MPXV. It also states that only tecovirimat has been approved by the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for the treatment of MPXV infection.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while the genome and structure of MPXV are similar to those of other OPXVs, the applicability of strategies used for other OPXVs to MPXV remains an area of uncertainty. Additionally, the review does not provide specific details on the mechanisms of action of the various antiviral agents discussed, leaving some evidence gaps in understanding their efficacy and potential for use against MPXV.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that further research is needed to explore the potential of antiviral agents against MPXV, particularly those with mechanisms of action that are not yet fully understood. papers.title_zh: 深入了解猴痘病毒感染的生命周期和治疗药物
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Since the first confirmed case in 1970, the monkeypox virus (MPXV) has emerged as a significant threat to global public health. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on two occasions. Despite decades of research, only tecovirimat has been approved by the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for the treatment of MPXV infection. The genome and structure are similar between MPXV and other orthopoxviruses (OPXVs), suggesting that the strategies used for other OPXVs may be applicable to MPXV. This review systematically summarizes the genome, structure, and critical stages in the life cycle of OPXVs, especially MPXV. A variety of antiviral agents against MPXV and other OPXVs are discussed according to their distinct mechanisms of action: 1) blocking viral entry and fusion, 2) inhibiting DNA replication and processing, 3) disrupting transcription and mRNA processing, 4) preventing virion assembly, maturation and release, 5) modulating immune responses, and 6) mechanism unknown. Overall, this article provides a systematic review of current research progress on potential therapeutic targets and agent for MPXV, aiming to offer innovative insights and strategies for the development of effective therapeutic agents against mpox.

papers.title: Comparison of diagnostic performance between the World Health Organization and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention real-time PCR assays for molecular detection of the mpox virus
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The global emergence and spread of monkeypox (mpox) have underscored the need for accurate and reliable molecular diagnostic tools. Real-time PCR remains the reference method for detecting mpox virus (MPXV); however, variations among available protocols may affect diagnostic performance. The objective of this study was to compare the diagnostic accuracy of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the USA real-time PCR assay with the World Health Organization (WHO) reference molecular protocol, using clinical samples from Ecuador. A retrospective analysis was conducted on 300 specimens from suspected mpox cases, including lesion swabs, vesicular samples, and serum, of which 150 were previously confirmed as MPXV-positive and 150 as MPXV-negative by the WHO assay. DNA was extracted using a standardized protocol, and all samples were tested with the CDC assay. The CDC protocol correctly identified 291 of 300 samples, yielding 141 true positives, 150 true negatives, 9 false negatives, and no false positives. The overall agreement was 97% (95% CI: 94–98), with a sensitivity of 94% (95% CI: 89–97) and a specificity of 100% (95% CI: 98–100). The positive predictive value was 100%, and the negative predictive value was 94% (95% CI: 90–97). The Cohen’s kappa coefficient obtained was 0.94 (95% CI: 0.90-0.98). These findings demonstrate that the CDC real-time PCR assay provides high diagnostic accuracy and excellent specificity for MPXV detection compared with the WHO reference protocol, supporting the use of both CDC and WHO real-time PCR assays as reliable diagnostic tools in clinical and surveillance settings. IMPORTANCE The global emergence and spread of MPXV have underscored the need for accurate PCR diagnostic tools. This is the first study to address a comparison between the PCR protocols for MPXV from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the USA real-time PCR assay and the World Health Organization (WHO), two institutions globally acknowledged as references for infectious disease diagnosis. We show that both PCR protocols are very reliable for MPXV diagnosis and could be implemented for any laboratory worldwide indistinctly.

papers.title: Serological differentiation between Mpox infection and vaccine-induced immunity: a mini-review
papers.abstract: In recent years, mpox has emerged as a significant global public health threat. The widespread distribution of the virus, coupled with the legacy of historical smallpox vaccination, has underscored the critical need to serologically distinguish between natural mpox infection and vaccine-induced humoral immune responses. However, the high antigenic similarity among Orthopoxvirus species leads to the production of cross-reactive antibodies, limiting the differentiation capacity of conventional serological assays. This mini-review evaluates current serological approaches aimed at discriminating between mpox infection and vaccine-induced immunity. Specifically, we analyze multiplexed immunoassays, comparative ratios based on orthologous antigens, machine learning-supported serological models, peptide-based platforms, and recombinant protein-based enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) methods. The findings of this review indicate that multiplex immunoassays, orthologous antigen ratio-based approaches, and machine learning algorithms exhibit the highest discriminatory potential for distinguishing natural mpox infection from vaccine-induced immune responses. In addition, MPXV A27L and ATI-N-CPXV antigens may be considered promising candidates for serological differentiation, although their performance requires further investigation.

papers.title: Longitudinal trends in copy-years viremia associated with mpox acquisition but not mpox severity in people with HIV
papers.abstract: Objectives: High viral load and low CD4 + cell count may be associated with increased risk of mpox acquisition. However, prior studies have not evaluated whether longitudinal trends in HIV lab measures, measured as the slope over time, are associated with mpox acquisition or severe mpox. Therefore, we evaluated whether longitudinal trends in CD4 + cell count (cells/μl), viral load (copies/ml), and copy-years viremia (CYV) (copies × years/ml) were associated with increased risk of mpox acquisition. Design: We conducted a nested case–control study among participants in the DC Cohort, a longitudinal study on people with HIV (PWH) in Washington, DC. Methods: Cases were defined as participants with mpox and were matched to five controls using risk set-sampling. Both two-stage modeling and joint modeling approaches were used to evaluate whether longitudinal trends in CD4 + cell count, viral load, and CYV were associated with mpox acquisition. Results: We evaluated 53 cases of mpox and 248 matched controls, with 13.7% of cases having severe mpox. An increased slope of CYV was associated with an increased risk of mpox acquisition based on the joint modeling approach, after adjusting for AIDS and known antiretroviral regimen [hazard ratio (95% CI): 1.11 (1.04–1.18)]. Conclusion: Clinicians should consider a patient's entire history of viral load, not just viral load measured at one point in time, when evaluating risk of mpox.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed whether longitudinal trends in HIV-related laboratory measures are associated with mpox acquisition or severity among people with HIV, a population at elevated risk. Prior work had not evaluated slope-based trends in CD4+ cell count, viral load, or copy-years viremia (CYV) in relation to mpox outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A nested case–control study was conducted within the DC Cohort, a longitudinal cohort of people with HIV in Washington, DC. Cases with mpox were matched to five controls using risk set sampling.
analysis.methods: Two-stage and joint modeling approaches were used to assess associations between longitudinal trends in CD4+ cell count, viral load, and CYV and mpox acquisition. Cases and controls were matched and analyzed with adjustment for AIDS status and antiretroviral regimen.
analysis.main_results: Among 53 mpox cases and 248 matched controls, 13.7% of cases had severe mpox. An increased slope of CYV was associated with higher risk of mpox acquisition in joint modeling after adjustment [hazard ratio 1.11 (95% CI 1.04–1.18)].
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the association between rising CYV and mpox acquisition as evidence that cumulative viral burden over time, rather than single-point viral load, better predicts risk. They highlighted the novelty of using longitudinal slope-based metrics in this context.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that clinicians should incorporate longitudinal viral load histories into mpox risk assessment for people with HIV, potentially improving prevention strategies in this high-risk group.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s nested case–control design and reliance on existing cohort data limit causal inference and generalizability beyond the DC Cohort. Evidence strength is moderate due to sample size and potential unmeasured confounding.

analysis.summary_en: This nested case–control study within the DC Cohort evaluated whether longitudinal trends in HIV-related laboratory measures—CD4+ cell count, viral load, and copy-years viremia (CYV)—are associated with mpox acquisition or severity among people with HIV. Using two-stage and joint modeling approaches, the authors found that a rising CYV slope was associated with increased risk of mpox acquisition after adjusting for AIDS status and antiretroviral regimen [hazard ratio 1.11 (95% CI 1.04–1.18)]. Among 53 mpox cases and 248 matched controls, 13.7% had severe disease. The study interprets these results as evidence that cumulative viral burden over time, rather than single-point measurements, better predicts mpox risk. The authors recommend incorporating longitudinal viral load histories into clinical risk assessment for people with HIV. Limitations include the case–control design, modest sample size, and potential unmeasured confounding, yielding moderate-strength evidence.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在 DC 队列研究 内进行了一项巢式病例对照研究,这是一项针对华盛顿特区 HIV 感染者的纵向 队列研究。使用风险集抽样将 猴痘 病例与五个对照进行匹配。
elements_zh.methods: 使用两阶段联合建模方法来评估 CD4+ 细胞计数、病毒载量以及 CYV 和 猴痘 采集的纵向趋势之间的关联。通过调整艾滋病状况和抗逆转录病毒治疗方案,对病例和对照进行匹配和分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 53 例 猴痘 病例和 248 例匹配对照中,13.7% 的病例患有严重的 猴痘。CYV 斜率增加与调整后联合建模中获得 猴痘 的较高风险相关[风险比 1.11 (95% CI 1.04–1.18)]。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 CYV 上升和 猴痘 获取之间的关联解释为随着时间的推移累积病毒载量而不是单点病毒载量可以更好地预测风险的证据。他们强调了在这种情况下使用基于纵向坡度的指标的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,临床医生应将纵向病毒载量历史纳入 HIV 感染者的 猴痘 风险评估中,从而有可能改善这一高危人群的预防策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的嵌套病例对照设计和对现有 队列研究 数据的依赖限制了 DC 队列研究 之外的因果推断和普遍性。由于样本量和潜在的未测量的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.source_body_en: Objectives: High viral load and low CD4 + cell count may be associated with increased risk of mpox acquisition. However, prior studies have not evaluated whether longitudinal trends in HIV lab measures, measured as the slope over time, are associated with mpox acquisition or severe mpox. Therefore, we evaluated whether longitudinal trends in CD4 + cell count (cells/μl), viral load (copies/ml), and copy-years viremia (CYV) (copies × years/ml) were associated with increased risk of mpox acquisition. Design: We conducted a nested case–control study among participants in the DC Cohort, a longitudinal study on people with HIV (PWH) in Washington, DC. Methods: Cases were defined as participants with mpox and were matched to five controls using risk set-sampling. Both two-stage modeling and joint modeling approaches were used to evaluate whether longitudinal trends in CD4 + cell count, viral load, and CYV were associated with mpox acquisition. Results: We evaluated 53 cases of mpox and 248 matched controls, with 13.7% of cases having severe mpox. An increased slope of CYV was associated with an increased risk of mpox acquisition based on the joint modeling approach, after adjusting for AIDS and known antiretroviral regimen [hazard ratio (95% CI): 1.11 (1.04–1.18)]. Conclusion: Clinicians should consider a patient's entire history of viral load, not just viral load measured at one point in time, when evaluating risk of mpox.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Mpox poses public health risks due to its zoonotic spillover potential and sustained human-to-human transmission, creating a need to understand coupled animal-human transmission dynamics and evaluate interventions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study develops a coupled SVEIQR-SEI mathematical framework to model transmission between animal reservoirs and human populations, incorporating vaccination and quarantine interventions.
analysis.methods: The analysis establishes the basic reproduction number (R0 = max{Rr, Rh}) and proves local asymptotic stability of the disease-free equilibrium when R0 < 1 using mathematical modeling techniques.
analysis.main_results: The study demonstrates that the disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable when the basic reproduction number R0 is less than one.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the stability condition as indicating that interventions reducing R0 below one can prevent sustained transmission, highlighting the value of coupled modeling for mpox control strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that vaccination and quarantine interventions targeting both animal and human compartments can effectively reduce transmission risk and inform outbreak preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to mathematical analysis without empirical validation, reducing generalizability and leaving uncertainty about real-world applicability.

analysis.summary_en: This study models mpox transmission dynamics using a coupled SVEIQR-SEI framework that integrates animal reservoirs and human populations, incorporating vaccination and quarantine. The analysis defines the basic reproduction number R0 as the maximum of animal and human components and proves that the disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable when R0 is less than one. The authors interpret this stability condition as evidence that interventions reducing R0 below one can prevent sustained transmission. While mathematically rigorous, the study relies solely on theoretical modeling without empirical data, limiting the strength of its public health recommendations.

papers.title: Structure-Guided Design of a Next-Generation Multi-Epitope Subunit Vaccine Targeting the Monkeypox Virus H3L Glycoprotein with Predicted Innate and Adaptive Immune Engagement
papers.abstract: Abstract Purpose The monkeypox virus (MPXV) represents an escalating public health concern globally, necessitating the development of tailored vaccination strategies that function independently of prior smallpox immunization history. This investigation introduces a mechanistically-grounded, multi-epitope-based subunit vaccine formulation directed against the H3L surface-exposed glycoprotein, which fulfills critical biological functions, including viral-host cell interactions, nuclear chromatin remodeling, and IL1A-dependent inflammatory cascade triggering that results in multi-organ pathology. Methods The computational design pipeline integrated multiple complementary immunoinformatics tools namely IEDB, BepiPred-2.0, NetMHCpan EL 4.1, VaxiJen v2.0, AllerTOP and ToxinPred—to generate a curated collection of immunologically functional, non-allergenic, non-toxic CTL, HTL and B-cell determinants with anticipated coverage across approximately > 90% of global HLA allele distributions. An N-terminal β-defensin immunological adjuvant connected via an EAAAK linker was incorporated to potentiate innate immunity activation. Computational 3D structure prediction utilizing RoseTTAFold confirmed high-quality stereochemical properties. Results Molecular docking via HDOCK demonstrated energetically favorable, stable interactions between the vaccine construct and critical immune recognition molecules (TLR2, TLR4-MD2, MHC-I, MHC-II). Subsequent molecular dynamics simulations spanning 100 nanoseconds using GROMACS revealed sustained structural integrity and binding persistence across all vaccine-receptor pairings. Conclusion This construct is positioned as a highly promising immunogenic candidate for preclinical MPXV vaccine evaluation.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 代表了全球不断升级的公共卫生问题,因此需要开发独立于先前天花免疫史的定制 疫苗接种 策略。这项研究引入了一种基于机制的、基于多表位的亚基 疫苗 制剂,针对 H3L 表面暴露的糖蛋白,该制剂具有关键的生物学功能,包括病毒-宿主 细胞相互作用、核染色质重塑和 IL1A 依赖性炎症级联触发,从而导致多器官病理学。方法计算设计流程集成了多个互补的免疫信息学工具,即 IEDB、BepiPred-2.0、NetMHCpan EL 4.1、VaxiJen v2.0、AllerTOP 和 ToxinPred,以生成免疫功能、非过敏性、无毒 CTL、HTL 和 B 细胞决定簇的精选集合,预期覆盖约 > 90% 的全球 HLA 等位基因分布。通过 EAAAK 连接体连接的 N 端 β-防御素免疫佐剂被掺入以增强先天免疫激活。利用 RoseTTAFold 进行的计算 3D 结构预测证实了高质量的立体化学性质。结果通过 HDOCK 进行的分子对接证明了 疫苗 构建体与关键免疫识别分子(TLR2、TLR4-MD2、MHC-I、MHC-II)之间具有良好的、稳定的相互作用。随后使用 GROMACS 进行的 100 纳秒的分子动力学模拟揭示了所有 疫苗 受体配对的持续结构完整性和结合持久性。结论 该构建体被定位为临床前 MPXV 疫苗 评估的非常有前途的免疫原性候选者。

papers.title: Structure-Guided Repurposing of SARS-CoV-2 Compounds Identifies Putative Inhibitors of Mpox Viral Enzymes
papers.abstract: Abstract Mpox remains a therapeutically underserved orthopoxvirus infection, and clinical evidence reinforces the need for antivirals acting through mechanisms distinct from tecovirimat. This study investigated whether a SARS-CoV-2 antiviral chemical library could be repurposed against three structurally characterised Mpox targets: the core protease, VP39 mRNA cap methyltransferase and poxin nuclease. A hierarchical workflow integrating high-throughput and precision docking, interaction profiling, and molecular mechanics generalised Born surface area rescoring was applied across the three targets. Top-scoring core protease and VP39 complexes were further evaluated using 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations and pharmacokinetic prediction. Redocking reproduced the crystallographic poses with root-mean-square deviations of 1.46, 0.79 and 1.83 Å for the core protease, VP39 and poxin complexes, respectively. For Mpox protease inhibitors, J08_67 showed the most favourable static binding free energy (− 37.03 kcal/mol) and the most balanced predicted pharmacokinetic profile, whereas J02_11 demonstrated lower ligand displacement than the reference complex and an 85% persistent Lys126 hydrogen bond. J08_51 emerged as the principal VP39 candidate, retaining a favourable post-simulation binding energy (− 68.38 ± 10.25 kcal/mol) and sustained interactions with Asp95 and Arg114. For poxin, J02_14 showed the most coherent non-native energetic profile, although it remained weaker than the co-crystallised ligand and was not evaluated dynamically. These findings demonstrate that cross-viral chemical-space repurposing can generate target-specific Mpox lead hypotheses and that integrating solvation, ligand strain and dynamic stability improves prioritisation beyond docking scores. The identified candidates warrant biochemical validation and medicinal-chemistry optimisation.

papers.title: APOBEC3-driven attenuation of the 2022 global outbreak monkeypox virus relative to its clade IIb ancestor
papers.abstract: Abstract Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is a zoonotic virus endemic to Africa that has recently re-emerged, becoming the first orthopoxvirus with sustained human-to-human transmission since smallpox eradication. The 2022 global epidemic of MPXV was caused by Clade IIb virus (lineage B.1) that derived from the lineage A endemic to West Africa through APOBEC3 microevolution 1–3 . Here, comparison of lineage B.1 virus with its closest earlier A.1 ancestor reveals that despite only 46 nucleotide differences, lineage B.1 has attenuating phenotypic changes. Both viruses replicated equivalently in cell culture, but B.1 had defects in long-range spread, which mapped to APOBEC3 mutation E353K in OPG057 (F13L). MPXV B.1 was also defective in innate immune control, inducing higher IFNβ and innate immune signalling gene expression, and showing reduced capacity to suppress interleukin-1β-mediated responses, which mapped to APOBEC3 mutation R48C in OPG047 (F3L). Finally, MPXV B.1 had reduced virulence in a mouse model of MPXV infection relative to the ancestral A.1 strain. Our work demonstrates that the 2022 global outbreak MPXV was intrinsically attenuated, with attenuating mutations that are absent in concurrent, more severe clade IIb outbreaks. Our data also reveal that APOBEC3 editing is a mechanism of MPXV phenotypic variation, potentially contributing to clade evolution and competition.

papers.title: Dynamic modeling and optimal control of Mpox among MSM in a central Chinese city
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Since 2022, the mpox outbreak has become a global public health threat, with transmission mainly among men who have sex with men (MSM). Mpox is the only infectious disease other than Ebola to have been declared a PHEIC twice. Following its importation and local spread in China, developing prevention strategies is essential. This study aims to formulate the optimal control strategy for mpox within MSM population in urban China. Methods We developed a compartmental transmission dynamics model for mpox among MSM in a Chinese city. The framework extends SEIR by including asymptomatic infections ( A ) and symptomatic but undiagnosed infections ( B ) alongside S , E , I , R , with transmission arising from A , I , B . We then formulated an optimal control problem with 4 interventions: MSM community based prevention and control ( u 1 ), Early detection/Early treatment/Isolation ( u 2 ), Increasing medical consultation rate ( u 3 ), and Vaccination ( u 4 ), and evaluated 15 schemes over 100 days. In addition, we set several constant control combinations and compared their costs and effects with optimal control. Results In the no-control scenario simulation, cumulative infections reached 6331 by day 100. Across 15 optimal control schemes ranging from single to quadruple controls, implementing any scheme reduced total infections effectively. With a single control measure, u 1 achieved the best performance and averted 6238 infections. For dual control measures, u 1 + u 4 showed the strongest effect and averted 6250 infections. For triple control measures, u 1 + u 3 + u 4 averted 6256 infections. Quadruple control measures provided the most effective overall strategy and averted 6258 infections. The quadruple constant control settings C1–C5 averted 5980, 6202, 6154, 6165 and 6181 infections, respectively. Under quadruple controls, the accumulated control-only cost was 1209.57 for optimal control. The costs of constant control settings C1–C5 were 1260.00, 2845.00, 3600.00, 3015.00, and 4575.00, respectively. Conclusions The no-control simulation suggests that mpox transmission among MSM can produce a large number of infections. The optimal control measures can effectively control the epidemic. MSM community based prevention and control ( u 1 ) is the best single control measure. Quadruple control measures avert the largest number of infections overall. Compared with constant control measures, optimal control achieves higher effectiveness at comparable cost. Trial registration Clinical trial number: not applicable.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on the mpox outbreak among men who have sex with men (MSM) in a central Chinese city. It uses a compartmental transmission dynamics model to simulate mpox spread and evaluate optimal control strategies. The model incorporates asymptomatic (A) and symptomatic but undiagnosed (B) infections, alongside the standard SEIR compartments. The research highlights that without interventions, mpox could lead to 6331 infections within 100 days. The findings suggest that targeted interventions can significantly reduce mpox infections in urban MSM populations, providing valuable insights for public health planning.

papers.title: Development and Application of TaqMan qPCR Assays for Detecting Monkeypox Virus, Lumpy Skin Disease Virus, Goatpox Virus, Fowlpox Virus and Swinepox Virus in the Border Areas of Yunnan Province, China
papers.abstract: The re-emergence and spread of animal poxviruses pose a significant threat to global livestock economies and public health, highlighting the need for highprecision diagnostic and surveillance tools.In this study, we developed a panel of five independent TaqMan qPCR assays utilizing adenovirus-packaged pseudovirus standards for the detection of five major animal poxviruses: monkeypox virus (MPXV), lumpy skin disease virus (LSDV), goatpox virus (GTPV), fowlpox virus (FWPV), and swinepox virus (SWPV).The constructed pseudovirus standards demonstrated good stability, with coefficients of variation (CV) below 3.46%.All five assays showed high specificity and sensitivity.The assay was further evaluated through a large-scale epidemiological survey of clinical samples collected from the transboundary high-risk border areas of Yunnan Province, China.The surveillance revealed a baseline prevalence of 13.05% for LSDV in cattle and 2.84% for SWPV in pigs.This newly established qPCR assay offers a highly sensitive, specific, and biologically safe diagnostic toolset, which may serve as a potentially useful tool for poxvirus active surveillance and transboundary animal disease control.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决动物痘病毒的重新出现和传播对全球畜牧经济和公共卫生造成的威胁,强调需要高精度诊断和 监测 工具。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究通过对中国云南省跨境高风险边境地区的临床样本进行流行病学调查,开发并评估了五种 TaqMan qPCR 检测方法,用于检测猴痘病毒 (MPXV)、肿块性皮肤病病毒 (LSDV)、山羊痘病毒 (GTPV)、鸡痘病毒 (FWPV) 和猪痘病毒 (SWPV)。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员为五种痘病毒中的每一种构建了假病毒标准品,并评估了它们的稳定性、特异性和敏感性。他们通过对从云南省收集的临床样本进行大规模流行病学调查进一步测试了这些检测方法。
elements_zh.main_results: 监测 显示牛 LSDV 的基线 患病率 为 13.05%,猪 SWPV 的基线 患病率 为 2.84%。所有五种检测均表现出高特异性和敏感性,变异系数 (CV) 低于 3.46%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 新建立的qPCR检测提供了高度灵敏、特异且生物安全的诊断工具集,为痘病毒活性监测和跨境动物疾病控制提供了潜在有用的方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为制定针对动物痘病毒的针对性 监测 策略提供信息,特别是在高风险跨境地区,并有助于控制 猴痘 和猴痘等疾病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于摘要报告,这可能会限制分析的深度。然而,所提供的证据支持对检测目标痘病毒的检测性能有一定的信心。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a nurse-led public health response in managing mpox outbreaks. The background highlighted the need for efficient and scalable strategies to address mpox transmission and care in resource-limited settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a single county health department and focused on the transition to intradermal administration of the mpox vaccine. It involved a cohort of healthcare workers and patients receiving mpox vaccinations.
analysis.methods: The methods described the implementation of a nurse-led vaccination program, including training protocols for healthcare workers, logistical planning for vaccine distribution, and monitoring of adverse events and vaccine efficacy through standardized reporting systems.
analysis.main_results: The study reported that the nurse-led approach successfully increased vaccination rates and improved the efficiency of the public health response, with no significant adverse events observed during the implementation phase.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as evidence that nurse-led initiatives can enhance mpox vaccination programs, offering a novel model for public health response in the absence of specialized medical personnel.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that nurse-led strategies can be a viable and effective method for managing mpox outbreaks, particularly in areas with limited access to specialist healthcare providers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited to a single county, which may affect generalizability. However, the evidence is strong due to the direct observation of outcomes within the targeted population and the use of standardized reporting systems.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the effectiveness of a nurse-led public health response in managing mpox outbreaks. It describes the transition to intradermal administration of the mpox vaccine within a county health department, focusing on the implementation of a vaccination program led by healthcare workers. The methods include training protocols, logistical planning, and monitoring of adverse events and vaccine efficacy. The main results indicate that the nurse-led approach increased vaccination rates and improved the efficiency of the public health response without significant adverse events. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that nurse-led initiatives can enhance mpox vaccination programs, offering a novel model for public health response in resource-limited settings. The study's implications suggest that such strategies can be a viable method for managing mpox outbreaks, particularly in areas with limited access to specialist healthcare providers. The evidence is strong due to direct observation within the targeted population, but the study's single-county setting may limit generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估护士主导的公共卫生应对措施在管理 猴痘 暴发 方面的有效性。背景强调需要有效且可扩展的策略来解决 猴痘 传播 和资源有限环境中的护理问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是在一个县卫生部门进行的,重点是 猴痘 疫苗 向皮内给药的过渡。它涉及 队列研究 的医护人员和接受 猴痘 疫苗接种 的患者。

elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,护士主导的方法成功提高了 疫苗接种 率并提高了公共卫生应对的效率,在实施阶段没有观察到重大不良事件。

papers.title: Dual Burden of Conflicts and Healthcare Collapse in the Democratic Republic of Congo: A Call for Action.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Healthcare is protected under international humanitarian law through principles such as civilian–combatant distinction and necessity. However, rising attacks on medical personnel and facilities in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) represent serious violations of these laws, threatening uninterrupted care and undermining basic human rights. Objective This narrative review synthesizes literature to highlight the compounded public health impact of ongoing conflict and health system collapse in the DRC to guide context‐sensitive interventions and policy actions for sustainable recovery. Methods This narrative review synthesizes data up to 2025 from peer‐reviewed journals, accessed through PubMed, Google Scholar, World Health Organization (WHO), and World Bank databases, and other sources. Results At the time of this study, ongoing conflict in the DRC, especially in the eastern provinces, has severely undermined healthcare access. Armed violence has led to the complete destruction of over 70 health facilities in North Kivu and partial destruction of 15 facilities in South Kivu, displacement of 7.3 million people, and disrupted vaccination campaigns, worsening cholera, Mpox, malaria, and measles outbreaks. Maternal and child mortality remain high due to insecurity, destroyed maternity centers, and limited antenatal care. Over 25% of the population faces severe food insecurity, with over 2 million children acutely malnourished. Insecurity, aid worker attacks, poor infrastructure, corruption, weak coordination, and donor fatigue hinder sustained recovery. Conclusion The DRC faces a critical health crisis driven by conflict and healthcare system collapse. Urgent global action is required to protect health services, support frontline workers, and restore peace. Although some humanitarian responses have been implemented, sustainable, coordinated, context‐sensitive interventions and long‐term investments remain essential to uphold human rights and prevent further humanitarian catastrophe.

papers.title: Diagnostic performance of a field-deployable iiPCR platform and viral load dynamics of MPXV Clade IIb in a cohort with high prevalence of HIV
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Since 2022, the global outbreak of Mpox caused by the Mpox virus (MPXV) Clade IIb has underscored the need for timely and decentralized molecular diagnostics. Although quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR) remains the diagnostic gold standard, its infrastructure requirements may limit accessibility in resource-constrained settings. Insulated isothermal PCR (iiPCR) represents a potential field-deployable alternative; however, clinical validation data for MPXV remains limited. METHODS: We prospectively enrolled 24 qPCR-confirmed Mpox patients between 2023 and 2024. Multiple specimen types were tested using the POCKIT Central MPXV iiPCR system and reference qPCR. Analytical sensitivity was assessed using serial viral dilutions. Viral load dynamics were evaluated using cycle threshold (Ct) values across specimen types and days post-symptom onset. Phylogenetic characterization was performed using a four-gene Sanger sequencing approach. RESULTS: Both iiPCR and qPCR demonstrated identical analytical limits of detection at 10-1 PFU/mL and complete qualitative concordance in cultured samples. Lesion-derived specimens showed the highest detection rates (100%) and consistently lower Ct values, whereas non-lesion specimens exhibited lower and more variable positivity. No clear differences in viral load-based diagnostic performance were observed between people living with HIV receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART) and people without HIV. Phylogenetic analysis confirmed exclusive circulation of MPXV Clade IIb. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic performance of a field-deployable iiPCR platform for Mpox virus (MPXV) Clade IIb in a cohort with high HIV prevalence. The authors concluded that the iiPCR system achieved diagnostic performance comparable to qPCR, particularly for lesion-derived specimens. The study's findings are relevant for improving decentralized Mpox testing in HIV-prevalent populations, but the evidence is limited by the small sample size and specific setting.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:自2022年以来,由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) Clade IIb引起的全球暴发 猴痘强调了及时和分散的分子诊断的必要性。尽管定量实时 PCR (qPCR) 仍然是诊断黄金标准,但其基础设施要求可能会限制资源有限环境中的可访问性。保温等温 PCR (iiPCR) 是一种潜在的现场部署替代方案;然而,MPXV 的临床验证数据仍然有限。方法:我们在 2023 年至 2024 年间前瞻性招募了 24 名经 qPCR 确诊的 猴痘 患者。使用 POCKIT Central MPXV iiPCR 系统和参考 qPCR 测试了多种样本类型。使用系列病毒稀释液评估分析灵敏度。使用跨样本类型和症状出现后天数的循环阈值(Ct)来评估病毒载量动态。使用四基因桑格测序方法进行系统发育表征。结果:iiPCR 和 qPCR 均显示出相同的分析检测限(10-1 PFU/mL),并且培养样品的定性完全一致。病变来源的标本显示出最高的检出率 (100%) 和持续较低的 Ct 值,而非病变标本则表现出较低且变化更大的阳性率。在接受抗逆转录病毒治疗(ART)的艾滋病毒感染者和未感染艾滋病毒的人之间,没有观察到基于病毒载量的诊断表现存在明显差异。系统发育分析证实了 MPXV Clade IIb 的独家循环。结论:在评估的条件下,POCKIT Central iiPCR 系统实现了与 qPCR 相当的诊断性能,特别是对于病变来源的标本。在这种经 ART 治疗且免疫功能保留的 HIV 流行 队列研究 中,HIV 合并感染与诊断性能差异无关,支持 iiPCR 用于分散 猴痘 检测的潜在用途。

papers.title: Development of a dual-target qPCR assay for enhanced MPXV detection in wastewater and environmental matrices
papers.abstract: Abstract The emergence of mpox as a global public health concern demands accurate and efficient molecular diagnostic tools for surveillance and outbreak management. The single-plex mpox virus (MPXV)-specific assays targeting B7R and TNF receptor (G2R) genes are widely used for this purpose. However, single-target approaches are vulnerable to viral mutations and may exhibit variable sensitivity across viral lineages and sample matrices, necessitating complementary assays for confirmation. Hence, we developed a duplex qPCR assay, combining B7R and G2R assay targets, enhancing laboratory efficiency and detection reliability. The analytical performance of the novel duplex assay was evaluated against its single-plex formats using synthetic DNA controls comprising mpox clades I and II sequences. The duplex assay’s utility for detecting MPXV variants was further evaluated using isolates belonging to recent outbreak lineages (Clade IIb and Clade Ib) and 42 environmental samples. The B7R and G2R Generic (G2RG) duplex assay demonstrated comparable performance to their respective single-plex assays when tested against synthetic controls, isolates, and MPXV-positive environmental samples. The newly developed duplex assay potentially serves as a robust molecular tool for MPXV detection in various sample matrices, including challenging environmental matrices such as wastewater. Besides enhancing screening efficiency and reducing cost, the simultaneous detection of two targets ensures detection reliability and thereby reduces the risk of false-negative results even if mutations occur in one of the target regions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need for accurate and efficient molecular diagnostics to support mpox surveillance and outbreak management amid the virus's emergence as a global public health concern.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research developed a duplex qPCR assay targeting the B7R and G2R genes of mpox virus (MPXV) and evaluated its performance against single-plex formats using synthetic DNA controls, viral isolates from recent outbreak lineages (Clade IIb and Clade Ib), and 42 environmental samples.
analysis.methods: The duplex assay's analytical performance was assessed using synthetic controls comprising mpox clades I and II sequences, isolates from Clade IIb and Clade Ib, and MPXV-positive environmental samples, with comparisons made to single-plex assays.
analysis.main_results: The B7R and G2R Generic (G2RG) duplex assay demonstrated comparable performance to its single-plex counterparts when tested against synthetic controls, isolates, and MPXV-positive environmental samples.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the duplex assay as a robust molecular tool for MPXV detection across diverse sample matrices, including challenging environmental matrices such as wastewater, and highlight its potential to enhance screening efficiency and reduce false negatives by detecting two targets simultaneously.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The duplex assay may improve mpox surveillance by providing reliable detection in environmental and clinical matrices, supporting outbreak response and reducing diagnostic uncertainty due to mutations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to abstract-level data and does not report detailed assay performance metrics, sample sizes, statistical analyses, or broader validation across additional matrices or viral lineages, warranting cautious interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a duplex qPCR assay targeting the B7R and G2R genes of mpox virus (MPXV) to address limitations of single-target assays, which are vulnerable to viral mutations and variable sensitivity across lineages and sample matrices. The assay's performance was evaluated using synthetic DNA controls, recent outbreak isolates (Clade IIb and Clade Ib), and 42 environmental samples, demonstrating comparable results to single-plex formats. The authors propose the duplex assay as a robust tool for MPXV detection in wastewater and other challenging matrices, potentially enhancing surveillance efficiency and reducing false negatives by simultaneously detecting two targets. However, the evidence is confined to the abstract and lacks detailed performance metrics, statistical validation, or broader applicability assessments.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了在该病毒成为全球公共卫生问题的情况下对准确有效的分子诊断支持 猴痘 监测 和 暴发 管理的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种针对 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) B7R 和 G2R 基因的双重 qPCR 检测方法,并使用合成 DNA 对照、来自最近 暴发 谱系(Clade IIb 和 Clade Ib)的病毒分离株以及 42 个环境样本,评估了其相对于单重形式的性能。
elements_zh.methods: 使用包含 猴痘 进化枝 I 和 II 序列、来自进化枝 IIb 和进化枝 Ib 的分离株以及 MPXV 阳性环境样品的合成对照来评估双重测定的分析性能,并与单重测定进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 当针对合成对照、分离株和 MPXV 阳性环境样本进行测试时,B7R 和 G2R 通用 (G2RG) 双链检测显示出与其单链对应物相当的性能。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将双重检测解释为一种强大的分子工具,可用于跨不同样品基质(包括废水等具有挑战性的环境基质)检测 MPXV,并强调其通过同时检测两个目标来提高筛查效率和减少假阴性的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 双工检测可以通过在环境和临床基质中提供可靠的检测、支持 暴发 响应并减少 突变 导致的诊断不确定性来改进 猴痘 监测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于抽象水平的数据,没有报告详细的检测性能指标、样本量、统计分析或跨其他基质或病毒谱系的更广泛验证,需要谨慎解释。

papers.title_zh: 开发双靶点 qPCR 检测方法以增强废水和环境基质中 MPXV 的检测
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The emergence of mpox as a global public health concern demands accurate and efficient molecular diagnostic tools for surveillance and outbreak management. The single-plex mpox virus (MPXV)-specific assays targeting B7R and TNF receptor (G2R) genes are widely used for this purpose. However, single-target approaches are vulnerable to viral mutations and may exhibit variable sensitivity across viral lineages and sample matrices, necessitating complementary assays for confirmation. Hence, we developed a duplex qPCR assay, combining B7R and G2R assay targets, enhancing laboratory efficiency and detection reliability. The analytical performance of the novel duplex assay was evaluated against its single-plex formats using synthetic DNA controls comprising mpox clades I and II sequences. The duplex assay’s utility for detecting MPXV variants was further evaluated using isolates belonging to recent outbreak lineages (Clade IIb and Clade Ib) and 42 environmental samples. The B7R and G2R Generic (G2RG) duplex assay demonstrated comparable performance to their respective single-plex assays when tested against synthetic controls, isolates, and MPXV-positive environmental samples. The newly developed duplex assay potentially serves as a robust molecular tool for MPXV detection in various sample matrices, including challenging environmental matrices such as wastewater. Besides enhancing screening efficiency and reducing cost, the simultaneous detection of two targets ensures detection reliability and thereby reduces the risk of false-negative results even if mutations occur in one of the target regions.

papers.title: Rebuilding Public Trust Through Strategic Vaccine Communication: Lessons from Recent Global Health Emergencies and a Framework for Future Pandemic Preparedness
papers.abstract: Effective vaccine communication has become a defining challenge of global health emergency preparedness, as scientific advances in vaccine development have not been accompanied by comparable gains in public trust. Experiences from recent outbreaks, particularly Ebola, COVID-19, and mpox, demonstrate that vaccine availability alone is insufficient to achieve high vaccine uptake when communication is inconsistent, misinformation proliferates, and public confidence in health institutions is weakened. This narrative review critically synthesizes current evidence to examine the determinants of public trust, evaluate the strengths and limitations of existing vaccine communication strategies, and identify priorities for future research and policy. The review highlights five interconnected determinants of effective vaccine communication: institutional transparency, evidence-based messaging, trusted community partnerships, digital information monitoring, and continuous communication adaptation. It further identifies persistent challenges, including reactive communication approaches, political polarization, inequitable access to trustworthy information, and the growing influence of artificial intelligence-driven misinformation. Current evidence is also limited by the predominance of cross-sectional studies, underrepresentation of low- and middle-income countries, and insufficient evaluation of long-term trust-building interventions. To address these challenges, we propose the Adaptive Vaccine Trust Communication (AVTC) Framework, which conceptualizes vaccine communication as a continuous adaptive process rather than a one-way transfer of information. By integrating institutional transparency, evidence-based messaging, trusted community partnerships, digital information monitoring, and continuous feedback, the framework provides a practical roadmap for strengthening public trust, improving vaccine confidence, and enhancing preparedness for future global health emergencies.
